Container.Name: Homelab-Hub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Homelab Hub for monitoring and controlling Docker containers on this Unraid server. Designed to run on a user-defined internal Docker bridge network named docker-internal, while publishing only the WebUI port on the Unraid host.
Container.Requires: The image is published by GitHub Actions to ghcr.io/arnas1111/homelab-hub. The template uses Docker pull policy always so mutable tags like latest are refreshed when the container is recreated. For no outbound internet access, use a user-defined internal Docker bridge network named docker-internal, not a br0/macvlan network with its own container IP.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access Homelab Hub from your LAN. The container target must remain 8080.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Direct access to the Unraid Docker Engine. Read/write access is required for container controls.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Optional initial administrator password. Leave empty to create it in the Hub setup screen.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Optional session signing secret. Leave empty to generate and persist one under /data.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Display name for this Unraid server inside the Hub.

Config.Name: Internal Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal data directory. Normally leave unchanged.

Config.Name: Docker Host
Config.Description: Docker Engine socket used by the Hub. Normally leave unchanged.

Config.Name: MQTT Host
Config.Description: Zigbee2MQTT broker hostname. Empty disables Zigbee.

Config.Name: MQTT Port
Config.Description: Broker TCP port. Set explicitly for TLS.

Config.Name: Zigbee Base Topic
Config.Description: Must match the Zigbee2MQTT base topic.
